title.purpose: Popup header and CardTitle. The 16px ceiling.

body.purpose: Favorite title, organizer, location, Catatan textarea.

caption.purpose: Subtitle, meta lines, placeholder, flash notices — always muted-foreground.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: The only elevation. Card only, constant — never on hover, never larger.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions (button hover bg, chip swaps).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: transition-colors duration on outline buttons and toggles.

breakpoints.name: popup-fixed
breakpoints.purpose: The popup is a fixed 360px panel, not a responsive page. No breakpoints; layout must fit 360px always.

components.name: Card
components.description: A Favorite's container. Sharp corners, 1px hairline, the one constant shadow-sm.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); }

components.name: Card — active stage
components.description: A Favorite whose Status Lamar is Dilamar or Interview. Faint blue tint + blue-tinted border singles out the Lowongan the user is still acting on.
components.css: .ds-card-active { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 5%, var(--color-card)); }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: The only button in the popup. Border + transparent; hover fills muted. No filled primary exists — manual action must not look like authority.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 10px; font: 500 12px/1.3 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status chip — open
components.description: Pill-shaped, read-only. Buka = emerald. The pill shape is the state-signal affordance; never use it on a control.
components.css: .ds-chip { border-radius: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font: 600 10px/1.3 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-chip-open { color: oklch(0.596 0.118 149); }

components.name: Status chip — filling / closed
components.description: Mengisi = amber, Tutup = rose. Same pill, same sizing; only the semantic pair changes.

components.name: Stage chip — dilamar (primary)
components.description: Status Lamar = Dilamar uses the Field Blue pair (primary/10 over primary text). The one place blue becomes a chip.

components.name: Search input
components.description: 1px hairline, transparent, sharp corners. Focus is an outline, not a glow or border shift.
components.html: <input type="search" class="ds-input-search" placeholder="Cari favorit..." aria-label="Cari favorit" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 8px; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; min-width: 0; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Link primary
components.description: The exit to MagangHub. Blue, underlined on hover, sharp. Never an in-popup navigation.
components.css: .ds-link-primary { color: var(--color-primary); border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 8px; font: 500 12px/1.3 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-link-primary:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Group toggle
components.description: Full-width bar collapsing Favorites by Penyelenggara. The only section header in the popup.
components.css: .ds-group-toggle { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-muted) 40%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-group-toggle:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-group-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-group-glyph { font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); }

narrative.overview:
The popup reads like a field notebook: sharp-cornered, plain-faced, dependable. Geist's geometric sans sets a Swiss, instrument-like tone; the single calm blue (oklch 0.5 0.134 242.749) is the only chromatic voice and it is used sparingly — to mark the Lowongan a user is still acting on, the link back to MagangHub, and focus. Everything else is ink on paper: near-black foreground on pure white, with a light-gray border and a muted field carrying secondary surfaces. Depth is conveyed by 1px borders and the muted fill, not by shadow; the Card's faint shadow-sm is the only elevation and it never grows.

The form language is one form: the sharp rectangle (radius 0rem). Cards, buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, group toggles, and status chips are all square-cornered. The only curved form is the tiny dot that leads each status chip, carrying the chip's semantic color at 10px because the sera Badge itself is a borderless, fill-less uppercase text label. Depth is conveyed by 1px borders and the muted fill, not by shadow; the Card's faint shadow-sm is the only elevation and it never grows.

The system diverges from ADR-0004's original 'match MagangHub's own shadcn/Tailwind aesthetic' commitment: the preset establishes a distinct Field-Notebook identity (blue accent, sharp corners, Geist) rather than a neutral mirror of MagangHub. The injected content-script toggles still mirror MagangHub's 'Bagikan' geometry per ADR-0004 and are out of scope for this system.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp rectangles for every surface and control; status chips are sharp uppercase micro-labels with a tiny colored dot.
One accent (calm blue) used on ≤10% of any screen — active state, link, focus ring.
Flat by default; the single shadow-sm lives on the Card and never escalates.
Geist Variable for every role; hierarchy is size + weight, never a second typeface.
360px fixed popup; tight 8px rhythm; information-dense but calm.
Plain Indonesian copy; fixed vocabulary (Lowongan, Penyelenggara, Batch, Kuota, Pelamar, Favorite, Catatan, Status Lamar, Status Lowongan).

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Field Blue is used on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point — it marks the one Lowongan a user is acting on, the exit link, and focus. A blue button or blue header is a failure of restraint.

rules.name: The Status-Color Quarantine
rules.body: bg-emerald-100/text-emerald-700, bg-amber-100/text-amber-700, bg-rose-100/text-rose-700 are permitted only inside status chips and change-notice banners. They are state signals, never decoration, never a card background, never a button.

rules.name: The Destructive Reservation
rules.body: --destructive is for genuine failure only — Refresh gagal, import errors. Never use it for a reversible 'delete' affordance, and never as an accent.

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: The popup has no display/headline scale. 16px is the ceiling; if a screen needs a bigger headline, the screen is wrong for a 360px panel, not the type scale.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Geist Variable is the only family. Introducing a second typeface breaks the instrument voice; use weight and size for hierarchy instead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow is the Card's shadow-sm, and it is constant — never a hover shadow, never a popover shadow. If a new surface needs to feel raised, use a border or bg-muted, not a larger shadow.

rules.name: The Sharp-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every surface and control is square-cornered (radius 0). The only rounded-full in the system is the chip's leading dot, and only because a colored dot is the cleanest way to carry semantic color inside a fill-less label. Never put rounded-full on a button, input, card, or the chip itself.

dos: Do keep every surface and control square-cornered (--radius: 0rem); the only rounded-full is the status chip's leading dot.
Do use Field Blue (oklch(0.5 0.134 242.749)) only for the active-stage tint, the dilamar chip, the 'Buka di MagangHub' link, and focus — ≤10% of any screen.
Do convey depth with 1px --border and bg-muted; use shadow-sm only on Cards and never larger.
Do write UI copy in plain Indonesian using the fixed vocabulary from CONTEXT.md.
Do keep the popup at 360px; reach for an 8px rhythm (gap-2, space-y-2, p-3) before adding new spacing values.
Do degrade loudly to the user, silently to the page: role="status" banners for health/import states, never console.error in MagangHub's page.
donts: Don't introduce a filled primary button — Status Lamar is manual by design; a primary fill would imply authority the extension deliberately lacks. Outline buttons only.

Don't ship Svelte, shadcn-svelte, or this design system into the content script (ADR-0004). Injected UI is plain DOM in a closed Shadow DOM and mirrors MagangHub's 'Bagikan' geometry, not these tokens.
- Don't import the Button/buttonVariants module into FavoriteCard — combined with its $effect.pre + bind:value Catatan pattern it triggers a Svelte 5 reactivity bug that breaks save-on-blur. Use native <button> with inline sera classes there; the Button component is fine everywhere else.
- Don't replace the native Urutkan / Status Lamar <select> with the bits-ui Select — e2e relies on selectOption, which needs a real <select>. Style them sera-underline instead.
Don't use emerald/amber/rose outside status chips and the change-notice / health banners — they are state signals, not a palette.
Don't add a second typeface or a display size; Geist Variable at 12–16px is the whole hierarchy.
Don't use --destructive for anything but genuine failure (Refresh gagal, import error).
Don't claim a Chrome Web Store listing, users, ratings, press, or Kemnaker affiliation, or fabricate an icon/logo — none exist.

Don't treat this system as a mirror of MagangHub's aesthetic; the preset establishes a distinct Field-Notebook identity. If the project re-commits to ADR-0004's 'feel native to MagangHub' goal, this DESIGN.md and the preset must be revisited together.
